limitations: Physical samples are bounded real-mode 386EX cases, not DX or protected-mode hardware evidence; EXCP and excluded prefixes are not passes.
SGDT/SIDT high-base-byte behavior follows pinned PCjs observation despite contradictory original-manual wording; no pinned physical sample.
POP destination-fault restart and ESP-based effective-address ordering have pinned PCjs support; admitted hardware samples exclude exceptions.
The exact test386 ROM stops at privilege-changing IRET after POST20; it is not accepted.
The 386 AT BIOS reaches POST2A then the firmware CLI/HLT error path F000:0C93. The budget outcome is diagnostic only, not boot acceptance.
Task switching, VM86 and privilege-changing gates/returns remain unsupported in this snapshot.
